The measure notes are split across these pages:

- [Sigma-Algebras](measures-sigma-algebras.qmd):
  $\sigma$-algebras, generated $\sigma$-algebras, and the Borel $\sigma$-algebra.
- [Additivity](measures-additivity.qmd):
  finite and countable additivity.
- [Measures and Probability Measures](measures-measure-spaces.qmd):
  measures, the counting and Lebesgue measures, measure spaces, null sets,
  $\sigma$-finite measures, probability measures, and probability spaces.
- [Measurable Functions and Integrals](measures-integrals.qmd):
  measurable functions, the integral, and absolutely integrable functions.
- [$L^p$ Spaces](measures-lp-spaces.qmd):
  $L^p$ norms and spaces, the essential supremum, and the Hölder and Minkowski inequalities.
- [Product Measures](measures-product.qmd):
  product $\sigma$-algebras and product measures.

A link to a section, theorem or definition on this page from before the split
goes on to the page that now holds it.

## Further reading {#sec-further-reading}

- @billingsley1995probability
  develops measure theory and builds probability on it.
  Its early chapters define $\sigma$-algebras, measures, and their basic properties.
- @folland1999real
  is a graduate text on measure and integration;
  its first chapters treat $\sigma$-algebras and measures.
- @gut2013
  is a graduate course in probability
  that opens with a chapter on introductory measure theory.
